title: Identification of biomarkers and mechanism exploration of ferroptosis related genes regulated by m6A in type 2 diabetes mellitus.
authors: Wang, Jing; Li, Xuying; Geng, Juan; Wang, Ruiduo; Ma, Gang; Liu, Pan
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过ANN和分子对接分析T2DM中m6A相关铁死亡基因及TF-mRNA网络，但核心是疾病生物标志物而非蛋白质-DNA互作机制建模，仅涉及TF调控网络预测，缺乏三维互作与动态机理研究。
abstract: PURPOSE: This study is aims to explore the role of ferroptosis genes regulated by N6-methyladenosine (m6A) in Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM). MATERIAL AND METHODS: Firstly, differentially expressed m6A-FRGs (DEm6A-FRGs) were obtained by intersecting the differentially expressed genes (DEGs) and the m6A-related ferroptosis genes (m6A-FRGs). After enrichment analysis of DEm6A-FRGs, artificial neural network (ANN) and nomogram models were constructed using 4 biomarkers. Moreover, the gene set enrichment analysis of biomarkers was performed. Furthermore, the transcription factors (TF)-mRNA and competing endogenous RNAs (ceRNA) regulatory networks were constructed to reveal the potential regulation of biomarkers at molecular level. In addition, the targeted drugs of biomarkers were predicted, and the molecular docking was used to study the inter-molecular interactions between biomarkers and targeted drugs by "AutoDockvina". RESULTS: Totals of 10 DEm6A-FRGs were obtained by intersecting the 402 DEGs and 299 m6A-FRGs. Moreover, the ANN model and nomogram model were constructed with 4 biomarkers including CDKN1A, MIOX, MYCN and CD82, among them, CDKN1A was the most important biomarker for forecasting T2DM. Notably, the function of extracellular matrix structural constituent was low expression in CD82 and MIOX, the function of mitochondrial protein-containing complex was high expression in CD82 and CDKN1A. Furthermore, TP63 could regulate CD82, CDKN1A and MIOX, GATA3 could regulate CD82, CDKN1A and MYCN at the same time. The ceRNA network was constructed with 4 mRNAs, 51 miRNAs and 37 lncRNAs, among them, XIST was a key lncRNA that associated with 12 miRNAs, which could influence CDKN1A. In addition, bisphenol A was associated with CD82 and MYCN, CGP 25608 was associated with CDKN1A and MIOX. CONCLUSION: This study revealed the potential molecular mechanisms of m6A-related ferroptosis genes in T2DM, which could provide novel insights for the clinical diagnosis and treatment of T2DM.
abstract_zh: 目的：本研究旨在探讨N6-甲基腺苷（m6A）调控的铁死亡基因在2型糖尿病（T2DM）中的作用。材料与方法：首先，通过交集差异表达基因（DEGs）与m6A相关铁死亡基因（m6A-FRGs），获得差异表达的m6A-FRGs（DEm6A-FRGs）。在对DEm6A-FRGs进行富集分析后，利用4个生物标志物构建了人工神经网络（ANN）和列线图模型。此外，对生物标志物进行了基因集富集分析。进一步，构建了转录因子（TF）-mRNA和竞争性内源RNA（ceRNA）调控网络，以揭示生物标志物在分子水平上的潜在调控机制。另外，预测了生物标志物的靶向药物，并使用“AutoDockvina”进行分子对接，以研究生物标志物与靶向药物之间的分子间相互作用。结果：通过交集402个DEGs和299个m6A-FRGs，共获得10个DEm6A-FRGs。此外，利用包括CDKN1A、MIOX、MYCN和CD82在内的4个生物标志物构建了ANN模型和列线图模型，其中CDKN1A是预测T2DM最重要的生物标志物。值得注意的是，细胞外基质结构成分的功能在CD82和MIOX中低表达，而线粒体蛋白复合物的功能在CD82和CDKN1A中高表达。此外，TP63可调控CD82、CDKN1A和MIOX，GATA3可同时调控CD82、CDKN1A和MYCN。ceRNA网络由4个mRNA、51个miRNA和37个lncRNA构建，其中XIST是与12个miRNA相关的关键lncRNA，可能影响CDKN1A。另外，双酚A与CD82和MYCN相关，CGP 25608与CDKN1A和MIOX相关。结论：本研究揭示了m6A相关铁死亡基因在T2DM中的潜在分子机制，可为T2DM的临床诊断和治疗提供新的见解。
